[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#ffe599][b]Will you be updating this mod[/b]? [/color]
I might if people have furniture suggestions and I feel interested in doing them. If there are any errors, I will also do my best to update this mod, too.
[b]
[color=#ffe599]How did you center the table with the couch? [/color]
[/b]That's because I actually made the tables into couches, too! You can view them under the BrownCouch. Using this method will allow you to center things more easily with a 3x2 dimension. 
[b]
[color=#ffe599]How do I re-texture my furniture?[/color][/b][color=#ffe599] [/color]
Make sure you download the Alternative Textures mod and then go to Robin's house to buy a paint bucket. After that, use the Paint Bucket tool on any of the items I have listed in the "New Furnitures" section above this post.
[b]
[color=#ffe599]Will you make this compatible with Mobile?[/color][/b][color=#ffe599] [/color]
It would require some time.. and probably some ingenuity. Right now, the only way to do this is to make this mod a Content Patcher mod. That's not easy, as a CP mod only replaces the default furniture of Stardew with my furniture,.. and unfortunately, I have more furniture items than the default Stardew Valley's furniture. I will maybe do this in the future if I get enough requests.
[b]
[color=#ffe599]Can I edit this mod? [/color]
[/b]You may do so, but please ask me for permission if you intend on posting it! 

[color=#ffe599][b]Does this mod replace my furniture? 
[/b][/color][/font]No. It gives your furniture an alternative texture you can pick from when you use the paint bucket tool.
